headline: What Does eBay (EBAY) Face After Carl Icahn Demands A Board Overhaul?
summary: Carl Icahn launches activist campaign targeting eBay (NasdaqGS: EBAY), urging a spin off of PayPal and major board changes. Icahn alleges conflicts of interest on eBay's board and questions past related party transactions. The activist letter calls for a separation of PayPal from eBay and a broad governance overhaul to reshape oversight.
